message.content:
The pain and the bloating have been getting worse gradually over the last few days. 

As for the nausea, I have been feeling very sick to my stomach, but I haven't actually thrown up yet. Regarding my bowels, I haven't been able to pass any gas or have a bowel movement for a little while now, which is making the distension feel even worse.
